description: Plan v7 section 8.3 runtime-limits clause: maximumExpressionCharacters pinned exactly at 17, the length of BOTH of this catalog's expressions — the whole-message alternative '(a > 0) && b == 1' and the generated-fragment predicate '(a > 1) && a == 2'. DefaultStrings compiles every loaded expression eagerly in its constructor (compileExpressions, calling ExpressionEvaluator.compile at DefaultStrings.java:576 for fragment predicates and 594 for whole-message alternatives) through an evaluator carrying the instance limits, so this fixture only builds at all if the implementation measures both sources at 17 UTF-16 units and treats validateExpressionSourceLength as strictly greater-than. Probe-verified against the real library: at limit 16 each expression is rejected by name.
